scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of a bearded warrior in a cream tunic and russet cloak, standing with an upright spear beside a stone wall and shield. A rocky path leads toward sunlit houses and distant hills beneath a blue sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The solitary warrior imaginatively represents Jephthah's valor; the spear and shield suggest his martial identity without inventing a battle. The verse also says his mother was a prostitute and his father was Gilead; neither parent is pictured. Face, clothing, village and landscape are artistic conventions, not historical likenesses or archaeological claims.
